title: Group Head of Finance (Legend)
description:
About Legend

Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising. Learn more at l1.com.

Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Group Head of Finance, reporting directly to our Finance Director.

In this role you will lead a 25+ person, multi-location team spanning Financial Reporting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury and Payroll. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate comfortably at both strategic and detailed levels: setting the direction for the function while stepping into complex operational and technical challenges when required.

Following Legend's acquisition, the finance function is operating in an environment of increased complexity and change. A key part of your role will be to evolve Legend’s finance operating model to meet these demands by strengthening controls and accountability, standardising and automating processes, improving systems and data flows, and building a scalable organisation that is less dependent on individual knowledge or manual intervention.

You will lead through an established team of finance leaders, developing their capability and creating clear ownership across the function while maintaining high standards of delivery. You will also play a critical role in building effective relationships across Legend and the wider Genius Sports group, balancing the requirements of both while supporting the team through significant organisational change.

This role would suit an experienced finance leader who is energised by transformation and ambiguity and has a track record of leaving finance functions materially more scalable, controlled and effective than they found them. 

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact:

• Lead Legend’s 25+ person, multi-location finance function across Financial Reporting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury and Payroll, creating clear accountability and ownership through the finance leadership team.

• Assess and evolve Legend’s finance operating model, ensuring organisational structure, process ownership, systems, controls and ways of working can scale with the business and wider Genius Sports group requirements.

• Lead end-to-end redesign and optimisation of core finance processes and systems, identifying opportunities to standardise, simplify and automate workflows while improving efficiency, controls and data quality.

• Establish clear process ownership, SLAs, controls and KPIs, using data to identify performance gaps, bottlenecks and opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Lead through managers and team leads, building their capability and empowering them to take ownership while remaining hands-on in complex operational and technical issues when required.

• Lead Legend’s finance function through post-acquisition integration, balancing the requirements of Legend and Genius Sports Group Finance and driving alignment across reporting, controls, systems, data and ways of working.

title: Senior Domain Expert, Total Rewards
description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Syndio is the leader in compensation equity and pay decision intelligence, helping the world's largest employers make fair, defensible, and transparent pay decisions at scale. As Decisions expands across the compensation lifecycle - from leveling and offers to promotions and merit - the compensation practice depth behind our recommendations has to keep pace.

The Senior Domain Expert (Total Rewards) is a hands-on compensation practitioner on the Applied Pay Intelligence team. Draw on your past experience in total rewards strategy as well as Syndio -provided training on pay equity best practices to provide expert advice on advanced pay equity topics to customers, fellow employees, and external audiences. This is a senior individual contributor role. You are the person our customers, our product, and the rest of the team turn to when the question is how pay should actually be structured - job architecture, market data, pay ranges, offer construction, geographic differentials - and how it should hold up in front of a CHRO, a comp committee, or a works council.

You own an area of Syndio 's compensation content and product surface, build the 1:many resources that scale your expertise across the customer base, partner directly with Product to embed compensation practice into Decisions and Essentials, and show up in the customer conversations where the design choices have to hold. You will translate custom analytics into product requirements and support product and development teams as needed on design and implementation plans, partner with the data science and development teams to ensure the product helps advance the outcomes of our total rewards customers.

Why this job is exciting

•
Lead a squad. You will be an individual contributor but you will own an area of Syndio 's compensation content and product surface - job architecture, market data integration, pay range design, offer intelligence, or a related domain. Guide the squad's roadmap, prioritize what gets built on the Applied Expertise team, and hold the practitioner bar for the work that ships.

•
Apply total rewards expertise in complex customer situations. Work through the design questions customers can't resolve inside the product: architecture redesigns, market data conflicts, range strategy, offer logic, geographic differentials. Bring the practice, explain the tradeoffs, defend the approach.

•
Build 1:many resources. Turn recurring compensation questions into durable content - customer briefings, design guides, model communication templates, worked examples - so recurring questions do not require a recurring meeting.

•
Partner with Product. Work directly with Product and AI teams to embed compensation practice into Decisions and Essentials. Shape offer recommendation logic, range and structure inputs, market data workflows. Catch the practitioner-level edge cases before customers do.

•
Show up for the moments that matter. Anchor customer QBRs, offer strategy conversations, and architecture reviews where the design has to hold up under CHRO or board scrutiny. Not every meeting - the ones where getting the structure and the framing right changes the outcome.

title: Senior AI Product Manager - Mobile Experience
description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Mobile Experience team. Our apps are where customers live with us day to day - recording trips, seeing their driving rating, managing their policy and getting help. For most of our customers, the app is Zego.

You’ll own a product domain within our apps, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping shape the longer-term direction of the Mobile Experience. You’ll lead discovery and delivery across iOS and Android, and use AI both to move faster and to build smarter experiences.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals, and help refine the longer-term plans for the Mobile Experience.

- Lead complex discovery autonomously, from customer research and design partnerships to opportunity solution trees and business cases.

- Craft mobile experiences customers prefer, from effortless onboarding to intuitive self-serve, that also cost less to serve.

- Validate before you build, using A/B tests, feature flags, staged rollouts and rapid prototypes to back or kill ideas early.

- Ship at pace in reusable building blocks across iOS and Android, working with engineering, design, data and compliance.

- Put the right metrics in place, from adoption and retention to app ratings and stability, and use them to drive continuous improvement.

- Establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain, and explore AI-powered experiences inside the app.

- Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

- Mobile product ownership. A track record of owning a consumer mobile app, or a major area of one, and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment.

- UX and customer instinct. You sweat the details of onboarding, permissions, notifications and accessibility, and know what makes great mobile experiences work.

- Experimentation mindset. Hands-on experience with A/B tests, feature flags and rapid prototypes. You default to evidence over opinion.

- Data and commercial fluency. Comfortable instrumenting events and analysing funnels in Amplitude, Looker or Snowflake, and building a business case around expected ROI.

- Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on native vs cross-platform trade-offs, APIs and release management. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

- Ownership and communication. A bias for action, and the ability to bring stakeholders with you across multiple teams.

- You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

You'll own spacecraft and payload structural analysis from conceptual design through environmental testing and launch. Unlike larger firms where analysts get siloed into statics or dynamics, you'll work across both. Most of our programs are early-stage, so you'll shape designs from the start and see your analysis carry hardware all the way to orbit.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Organized and willing to define scope for problems with undefined requirements.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with FEA software (ANSYS, Abaqus, or NASTRAN).

• Structural testing experience - sensor selection, data acquisition, and post-processing.

• Co-op or internship in a startup or fast-paced engineering environment.

• Familiarity with industry standards for materials (MMPDS) or analysis methodologies (GSFC-STD-7000, NASA-HDBK-7002, NASA-STD-5020).

• Eligibility to obtain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

title: Senior ML Systems Engineer, Inference
description:
Runpod is the AI Developer Cloud. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're at an inflection point for AI infrastructure, and we're building the platform the next generation of developers will depend on.

 

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.

 

Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.

We're looking for a ML Systems Engineer, Inference. We want Runpod to be the best place in the world to run LLM inference, meaning the fastest and the most cost-efficient. You'll lead that effort. You'll own LLM serving performance end to end. That means measuring it, understanding it, and improving it across models, hardware generations, and workloads. The work you ship will show up directly in the latency and cost our customers experience. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who likes finding the real bottleneck and fixing it, then turning that fix into something that runs reliably in production.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define how we measure inference performance, including throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency, and cost per token, and build the tooling that makes those measurements rigorous and repeatable.

- Profile and diagnose performance problems across the serving stack, from scheduling and memory management down to kernels and interconnect.

- Improve serving efficiency for large, state-of-the-art models on single-node and multi-node GPU deployments.

- Turn what you learn into production-ready runtimes, configurations, and defaults that customers benefit from automatically.

- Work closely with product and infrastructure teams to shape how inference is offered on Runpod.

- Keep up with the fast-moving inference ecosystem, including the open-source community, and decide what's worth adopting, what's worth building, and what's worth contributing back.

- Trace bottlenecks in the serving engine/runtime and implement fixes when configuration tuning is not enough.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of professional system engineering experience.

- Deep, hands-on experience with vLLM, SGLang (or a comparable serving engine) in production or at serious benchmark scale.

- Strong software engineering skills in Python. You're comfortable working in large, performance-critical codebases.

- A solid understanding of what drives LLM inference performance: batching, memory, parallelism, and the trade-offs between latency and throughput.

- Experience with modern inference optimization techniques such as quantization, speculative decoding, or distributed serving.

- Rigor in benchmarking and performance analysis, plus comfort with GPU profiling tools.

- The ability to explain your results clearly in writing and turn them into decisions.

PREFERRED

- Experience writing or tuning GPU kernels in CUDA or Triton.

- Contributions to inference or ML systems projects.

- Experience with multi-node GPU systems and high-speed networking.

- Experience at a company where inference cost and latency were core business metrics.

What You’ll Receive:

- The competitive base pay for this position ranges from ($150,000 - $220,000). This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Runpod and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location

- Meaningful equity in a fast-growing company- everyone on the team receives stock options - your impact drives our growth, and you share in the upside.

- Generous medical, dental & vision plans

title: Software Engineer (Python, React, TypeScript)
description:
About Cargobase

Cargobase is changing how enterprise shippers like Bosch, Reckitt Benckiser, Goodyear, and Textron, along with logistics providers like DHL, DSV, and FedEx, run spot-buy freight. This is a multi-billion dollar corner of logistics, and we're bringing the whole process online: quoting, tracking, invoice audit, and data insights.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on full-stack engineer who loves shipping across the stack and working AI-natively. You'll be a core builder on our small, high-trust team, helping us build agentic AI right into the product. You'll write the features our enterprise customers rely on and help set the technical bar for how we build and review code.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership & Execution

• Ship meaningful full-stack features end to end, from design through to production, spanning both the UI and the services behind it.

• Bring agentic AI into the product (for instance, extracting structured data from unstructured sources like emails and documents) and help figure out where AI genuinely makes the experience better.

• Keep the codebase healthy through pragmatic architecture, sensible data modeling across relational and NoSQL stores, and a steady habit of tackling tech debt.

Process & Operational Excellence

• Work AI-natively by using agentic coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code fluently, applying them with smart, context-aware judgment rather than brute force.

• Help shape the engineering practices and standards that keep us shipping quickly and reliably.

Internal & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Level up the whole team through thoughtful, high-quality code reviews, setting the bar for how we build and review.

• Work closely with teammates and partners across Product and QA, turning real customer needs into solid technical solutions.

What We're Looking For

• You have over 5 years of experience shipping production software as a full-stack engineer, with a genuine balance between frontend and backend work.

• On the frontend, you're strong with React and TypeScript, with enough depth to guide and review frontend work effectively.

• On the backend, you're strong with Python and have experience with Django, FastAPI, or Flask.

• You're comfortable with data modeling across both relational and NoSQL databases.

• Working with Docker and in containerized environments like Kubernetes feels like second nature to you.

• You already work AI-natively, or you have a clear enthusiasm and fluency for that way of working.

Nice to Have

• It's a bonus if you've built agentic or LLM features into a product: things like RAG, vector search, structured extraction, or agent tool-calling, even if just through side projects.

• Experience with AWS (especially EKS), CI/CD ownership, and observability tools is definitely a plus.

• A background in enterprise B2B SaaS is great, especially if it's in logistics or supply chain.

Our Stack

We use Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask), React, and TypeScript. Our data lives in relational and NoSQL databases, and we run on Docker and AWS (EKS) with solid CI/CD. We also love AI-native tools like Cursor and Claude Code.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

title: Video Editor
description:
About the role

Plan Left is hiring a Video Editor to turn our long-form content (webinars, podcasts, interviews and talks) into short, scroll-stopping clips that grow our B2B audience. You'll work closely with the marketing team, owning the edit from raw recording to platform-ready video for LinkedIn, YouTube and other channels.

This is a marketing role as much as an editing role: we want someone who knows what makes a business audience stop, watch and click.

What you'll do

• Review webinars, podcasts and recorded talks (30-90 minutes) and pull the strongest moments into short clips (15-90 seconds)

• Produce 15-25 short-form videos per week from each long-form piece, plus highlight reels and trailers

• Write or refine hooks, on-screen text, captions and titles that land with business buyers

• Format and optimize every clip for its platform: LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, Instagram, TikTok and paid ads

• Add motion graphics, subtitles, b-roll, branded intros and lower thirds consistent with our brand guidelines

• Partner with marketing to align clips with campaigns, product launches and demand-gen goals

• Track clip performance (views, watch time, engagement, clicks) and use it to improve the next batch

• Keep an organized library of source files, templates and finished assets

The creative side

We don't want clips that look like a webinar recording with captions slapped on. We want short-form content with a point of view that feels native to each platform and still fits a credible B2B brand.

You'll get creative ownership to:

•
Find the story. Spot the surprising stat, the contrarian opinion or the honest moment in an hour of talk, then build a clip with a clear beginning, tension and payoff

•
Hook in the first 2 seconds. Try cold opens, pattern interrupts, bold text and smart reordering so viewers keep watching

•
Bring talking heads to life. Use punch-ins, jump cuts, b-roll, kinetic typography, emoji and icon callouts, split screens and simple animations to keep the energy up

•
Use sound well. Pick music, sound effects and pacing that match the mood, from punchy and fast to calm and authoritative

•
Develop a visual style. Help shape and evolve recognizable templates, caption styles, color treatments and series formats for our channels

•
Pitch new formats. Suggest series, recurring segments, carousel-to-video ideas and trend-based edits that suit a B2B audience

•
Experiment and learn. Test different hooks, lengths, aspect ratios and styles, and double down on what works

We'd love to see you add your own taste to the work. Bring ideas, not just edits.

What we're looking for

Listed in order of priority.

•
Fluent English. Excellent written and spoken English. You'll write captions, hooks and on-screen copy, and you need to catch the nuance in what speakers say to find the best moments.

•
Marketing experience. 2+ years editing video for a marketing team or agency. You understand hooks, audience retention, calls to action and how content supports a funnel.

•
Long-form to short-form repurposing. A proven track record of turning webinars, podcasts or interviews into short clips. Your portfolio should show both the source and the clips you cut from it.

•
B2B marketing content. Experience editing for B2B brands such as SaaS, professional services or tech. You know how to make expert conversations engaging for decision-makers without losing credibility.

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role

Veeva Link’s vision is to build connected data applications that improve research and patient outcomes.

As a Senior Team Lead for one of our Data Operations teams, you will lead a remote team of 50+ freelancers who execute on large-scale data generation pipelines. You will design business processes and drive process improvements as well as technology improvements.

You plan and control these business processes and support their execution by removing barriers for your team members. Your primary focus is to improve process efficiency and reduce defects. As a first-line manager and servant leader, you deliver operational metrics associated with your process and results while keeping your team engaged.

To thrive in your role, you are highly motivated to lead and have a “can do” attitude. You are results-oriented, analytical, organized, and socially skilled. You communicate effectively with leadership, analysts, engineers and researchers.

The ideal candidate for this role has a strong interest in people management, a process-oriented mindset, and an excellent work ethic. Whether you choose to work at home or in one of our offices, you enjoy working with autonomy and in an international environment. We have a great remote working culture where people work hard, have fun, and grow.

What You'll Do

•
Empower and Scale a Large Organization: Confidently lead, mentor, and build a dynamic, proactive, and high-performing remote team with a headcount of 50+

•
Drive Operational Excellence: Take full ownership of your team’s KPIs and its performance, driving measurable results and holding a high bar for success

•
Champion Continuous Improvement: Spearhead and implement impactful quality and efficiency projects to constantly elevate our data operations

•
Pioneer AI-Driven Solutions: Identify opportunities and lead the integration of artificial intelligence into operational workflows to accelerate web research, enhance data quality, and drive next-level automation

•
Shape the Technology Landscape: Partner and collaborate closely with the engineering teams to build innovative tooling and scale process automation

•
Proactive Risk Management: Act decisively to identify and escalate all risks and incidents early and unambiguously, ensuring smooth and reliable operations

Requirements

•
Proven Leadership: You bring extensive people leadership experience (5+ years), with a clear track record of mentoring, scaling, and inspiring high-performing teams

•
Process Architecture Expertise: You possess proven, hands-on knowledge in business process design, management, and optimization to consistently drive efficiency and quality

•
Operational Track Record: You have 3-5 years of dedicated working experience in a relevant operational or data-driven capacity, complementing your broader leadership background

•
Global & Remote Readiness: You are highly comfortable and effective working remotely, thriving autonomously within a diverse and fast-paced international environment

Nice to Have

• Connection with life sciences (education or professional experience)

title: Customer service manager (PL)
description:
ParcelHero is one of the UK's biggest parcel delivery price comparison sites, with over 5 million visitors a year. We're a scaling, technology-focused business with 120 remote staff worldwide - and we're growing fast, expanding internationally into the US and Europe this year.

We serve both consumers and businesses in an almost 50/50 split, and our move into SaaS is shifting that mix further towards larger businesses and, ultimately, enterprise customers. In 2026, we launched our cutting-edge TMS (Transport Management Solution), Parcelhero Pro, enabling retailers to pay a monthly subscription to ship on their own carrier accounts and manage every aspect of their logistics through our platform.

We're a highly innovative company, deeply focused on optimisation, automation, and continuous process improvement. Joining now means being part of the journey - helping shape our technology, our processes, and our approach as we scale globally.

We're also a remote-first business: no commute, no office politics, just great work with talented colleagues around the world.

Job description
Are you passionate about improving the customer experience? Does coordinating across teams, countries, and time zones excite you? Parcelhero is looking for an experienced Customer Service Manager to lead our team leaders and 50-strong remote team, drive quality of service, and elevate the experience for both our consumer and business customers as we expand internationally.
This is a high-pace, high-pressure environment. You'll need to be decisive, sharp, and comfortable making fast, sound judgement calls while managing competing priorities across departments and time zones. As our customer base shifts towards larger business and enterprise customers, you'll help evolve our service to meet their expectations.
You will be responsible for driving cross-department collaboration between the customer service, customer experience, and QA teams - working closely with them to optimise processes and continuously improve the customer experience as we scale.
Responsibilities

Team Leadership: Manage and develop a team of team leaders overseeing a 50-strong remote customer service team, setting clear performance expectations and fostering high performance under pressure.

Cross- Department Collaboration: Work closely with the Customer Experience and QA teams on customer journey optimisation, process improvement, and automation initiatives - ensuring the customer service team's insights and frontline experience feed directly into these efforts.

Customer Feedback Management: Collect and analyse customer feedback (e.g., surveys, reviews) alongside the Customer Experience team to identify pain points and opportunities to enhance the overall experience.

Service Quality and Metrics: Track and improve key service metrics, such as Net Promoter Score (NPS), customer satisfaction, and customer effort score, driving quality of service across the team.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with marketing, product, and technology teams to ensure all customer touchpoints (website, booking platform, support) align with customer needs and expectations.

Custom er Communication Strategy: Develop communication strategies to improve how customers are informed about delivery updates, service disruptions, and issue resolutions.

Service Innovation: Identify opportunities to introduce new services, tools, or processes that enhance the customer experience, working with the relevant teams to bring them to life.

Customer Education: Support initiatives to provide customers with educational content (e.g., how-to guides, FAQs) to improve self-service options and reduce the need for support.

Vendor Relationship Management: Liaise with courier partners (DHL, FedEx, UPS) to ensure they provide services that meet or exceed customer expectations.

Applicant criteria

• A minimum of 10 years' customer service experience.

• A minimum of 7 years' experience in a customer service management rol

title: Head of Supply Planning & Replenishment
description:
Rohlík Group is one of Europe’s fastest-growing online grocery platforms, changing how people eat and live. Founded in 2014 in the Czech Republic, we’ve grown into a trusted brand with more than one million customers across Czechia, Hungary, Austria, Germany, and Romania.

Rohlik is transforming how people buy food - faster, smarter, and with an obsession for quality. Czech Republic is our largest and most complex market, serving over a million customers across Europe. Now we’re looking for a Head of Supply Planning & Replenishment who will take full ownership of product availability, inventory performance, supplier reliability and automation - and lead our supply chain into its next stage of growth.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- Real impact from day one - You’ll own the supply chain for our biggest market, directly shaping the experience of millions of customers.

- No corporate red tape - Fast decisions, no waiting around for HQ approvals. Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately.

- Deliberately hands-on - You won’t just sit back and set strategy in presentations; you will build the reporting, analyze the KPIs, and actively improve how the department works.

- AI-first tech stack - You’ll have access to top-notch tools and the freedom to use technology pragmatically to automate manual work.

- Lead from the front - You’ll lead a tight-knit team of max 10 people. This is a role for someone who wants to make things move fast and be in the trenches with their team.

- You’ll work closely with C-level leadership, Tech, Category and Operations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Head of Supply Planning & Replenishment, you own the performance across all fulfillment centers and categories. We expect you to be highly independent, tech-capable, and continuously looking to improve your own knowledge.

You will:

- Run the day-to-day operations: You will lead the morning calls, dive deep into the daily metrics, and own KPIs such as availability, stock health, shrink, and OTIF.

- Lead and build the team: Manage a small team of 8 people. You will guide and mentor them, but you are also close enough to the work to do it yourself when that is the fastest way to get things done.

- Analyze and report: You won't wait for others to hand you insights. You will build your own reporting, analyze the KPIs, and use raw data to make smarter, faster decisions.

- Drive efficiency and automation: Work actively with AI and modern tools to remove inefficiencies, automate ordering exceptions, and optimize how the function operates. You aren't just managing the process; you are rebuilding it to be better.

- Continuously learn: You don't need to know everything on day one, but you must work tirelessly to acquire new knowledge, understand the tech, and improve the company. We move fast, and you will need to adapt and grow just as quickly

WHAT YOU BRING

We are not looking for decades of extensive senior leadership experience. We are looking for a sharp, driven professional who wants to build, optimize, and learn at lightning speed. You will balance strategy with hands-on execution.

- 3+ years of experience in supply chain, retail, logistics, or operations. You have the foundational knowledge of ordering, inventory management, and KPIs-and the relentless drive to learn the rest. Understanding of fresh/chilled/dry supply chains is an advantage.

- A hands-on, builder mindset. You are as comfortable leading a team as you are diving into raw data to fix a broken process.

- Tech-capable and AI-curious. You are highly proficient with data and eager to use AI and modern tools to automate manual work. You want to use technology to actually solve problems, not just talk about them.

- Ownership and drive. You set baselines, take responsibility, hit deadlines, and proactively look for ways to improve yourself and your department. You believe "better done than perfect" beats waiting for the perfect slide deck.

- Languages: Fluent Czech/Slovak and advanced Engl

title: Server Specialist
description:
Role Profile - Server Specialist
Job Summary
The Server Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining server infrastructure to ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability. This role involves managing physical and virtual servers, storage systems, and related technologies, while providing technical expertise and support to internal teams.
Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, and maintain Windows/Linux servers and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

• Monitor server performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement corrective actions.

• Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.

• Perform regular backups and disaster recovery planning.

• Apply security patches and updates to maintain compliance.

• Collaborate with network and application teams for system integration.

• Document configurations, processes, and troubleshooting steps.

• Provide Tier 2/3 support for server-related incidents.

• Plan and execute server migrations and upgrades.

• Implement and maintain high-availability and failover solutions.

• Monitor and optimize resource utilization across servers and storage.

• Ensure compliance with organizational security policies and industry standards.

• Develop and maintain automation scripts for routine tasks (PowerShell, Bash).

• Participate in capacity planning and forecasting for server infrastructure.

• Assist in cloud integration and hybrid environment management (Azure/AWS).

• Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and remediation.

• Train and mentor junior IT staff on server technologies and best practices.

• Prepare reports on server health, performance, and utilization for management.

Required Knowledge

• Operating Systems: Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Linux distributions (Ubuntu, Red Hat).

• Virtualization: VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V.

• Storage: SAN/NAS technologies, RAID configurations.

• Networking Basics: TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls.

• Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS (preferred).

• Security: Server hardening, patch management, antivirus solutions.

• Backup & Recovery: Veeam, Commvault, or similar tools.

• 3-5 years of hands-on experience in server administration.

• Experience in managing enterprise-level infrastructure.

• Proven track record in troubleshooting complex server issues.

• Familiarity with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem management).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

• Proficiency in scripting (PowerShell, Bash) for automation.

• Team-oriented with the ability to work independently.

• Certifications (Preferred)

• Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate.

• VMware Certified Professional (VCP).

• CompTIA Server+ or equivalent.

title: Expert Financial Performance & Value Creation (m/w/d)
description:
DIE CHANCE

Steuerberatungen rechnen rückwärts. Sie wissen genau, was im letzten Jahr passiert ist, und erstaunlich wenig darüber, welches Mandat, welche Leistung und welcher Mitarbeiter morgen Geld verdient.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen aus dem Bestand und durch Übernahmen. Beides stellt dieselbe Frage in zwei Formen: Was verdienen unsere Mandate, Leistungen und Teams tatsächlich, und was folgt daraus für die nächsten zwölf Monate.

Die Rolle ist auf ein bis drei Jahre Beratungserfahrung zugeschnitten. Du treibst die finanzielle Steuerung von der Ertragsseite her. Du siehst auf die Zahlen, erkennst, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, und gehst damit zu den Menschen, die es ändern können, auch wenn das Gespräch unangenehm wird. So lange, bis die Wirkung in den Zahlen steht. Du berichtest an Moritz Bonacker.

WAS DU VERANTWORTEST

Ertragskraft und Produktivität

- Durchleuchte die Bestände auf den echten Daten des laufenden Rechnungswesens, von der Mandatsgröße bis zum Deckungsbeitrag, und mach sichtbar, was heute stillschweigend miterbracht und nicht abgerechnet wird.

- Bewerte die Produktivität auf beiden Seiten: je Leistungsart, welche ihren Deckungsbeitrag trägt und welche quersubventioniert wird, und je Mitarbeiter, wo Wertschöpfung je eingesetzter Stunde entsteht.

- Dein Maßstab: keine Analyse ohne benannte Maßnahme, benannten Verantwortlichen und benanntes Datum.

Durchsetzung

- Führ die Honorargespräche selbst oder mit einem Berufsträger an deiner Seite. Und sprich auch die unangenehmen Fälle aus: Nicht jedes Mandat hat einen Weg in die Profitabilität.

- Geh mit deinen Zahlen direkt zu den fachlich Verantwortlichen: was ihre Mandate und Teams produzieren, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, was sich konkret ändern muss.

- Verfolge die Maßnahmen nach, bis das Ergebnis in den Zahlen steht. Auch wenn es unbequem wird.

Zukauf und Vorausschau

- Entwickle je Übernahme den Wertsteigerungsplan auf der finanziellen Seite und verfolge ihn über Jahre statt über hundert Tage. Dein Maßstab: Die dritte Übernahme läuft besser als die erste, weil du beide gemacht hast.

- Verantworte Umsatz- und Ergebnisprognose, Budgets, Szenarien und Abweichungsanalysen über alle Standorte, auch die neu dazugekommenen.

- Automatisiere, was du baust. Keine Auswertung, die jemand monatlich manuell zusammensetzt.

FRAGEN, AUF DIE DU DIE ANTWORT FINDEST

- Ein Mandat trägt seinen Deckungsbeitrag nicht, die Beziehung besteht seit fünfzehn Jahren: Wie gehst du in dieses Gespräch, und wo ist deine Grenze?

- Woran unterscheidest du eine Leistung, die zu billig ist, von einer, die zu aufwendig erbracht wird?

- Deine Empfehlung wird von jemandem blockiert, der dir nicht berichtet. Was tust du, wenn das zweite Gespräch auch nichts bringt?

WORAN WIR ERFOLG MESSEN

- Nach 6 Monaten: Der erste Bestand ist vollständig durchgerechnet, Deckungsbeitrag je Mandat und Leistungsart liegen belastbar vor, die erste Auswertung läuft automatisiert, die ersten Honorargespräche hast du selbst geführt.

- Nach 12 Monaten: Die erste Anpassungswelle ist über den Bestand gefahren, das erreichte Honorarniveau nachgewiesen. Die Deckungsbeitragsrechnung wird in Führungsentscheidungen verwendet. Deine Prognose trägt, ihre Abweichung kannst du erklären.

- Nach 24 Monaten: Mehrere Übernahmen begleitet, die spätere lief nachweislich besser als die erste. Die Steuerung läuft weitgehend automatisiert, dein Anteil hat sich von der Aufbereitung zur Interpretation verschoben.

- Wohin es führt: in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn, mit größerem Themenfeld und mehr methodischer Autorität. Willst du ein Team aufbauen, steht dir die Führungslaufbahn ebenso offen. Entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Du hast ein bis drei Jahre in der Beratung gearbeitet,

title: Business Development Manager

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love-driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the role

Our Business Development Reps (BDRs) are the first people new brands meet at ShopMy. They find brands that fit, start the conversation, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. That net-new pipeline is where most of our new revenue starts.

The BDR team is scaling quickly, and we're hiring a Business Development Manager to help lead it. You'll own a pod of BDRs, coach them day to day, hit your team's meeting and pipeline goals, and build the systems that let the team keep growing. You'll work closely with our AEs, RevOps and Enablement teams.

This is a player-coach role. You should be able to jump on a call, rewrite an email, or build a target list alongside your reps, then turn what works into something the whole team can use.

What you'll do

Lead and coach your team

• Manage a pod of BDRs with weekly 1:1s, clear goals and direct feedback

• Review outreach with reps and coach them in the moment on messaging, objection handling and booking meetings

• Spot who's struggling early and build a plan with them to get back on track

• Develop reps into their next role, whether that's AE or another cross-functional role

• Help interview and hire new BDRs as the team grows

Own the number

• Own your team's monthly and quarterly goals for meetings booked and qualified pipeline

• Partner with the Brand Growth team on which brands and segments each rep should target

Build how the team works

• Create and refine outreach playbooks, email templates, account trackers and prioritization strategies

• Onboard new BDRs so they ramp faster

• Work with Enablement on training, and bring what's working in the field back to them

• Keep Salesforce clean so everyone can trust the pipeline numbers

Work across teams

• Partner with AE managers so meetings are handed off smoothly and AEs get the context they need

• Share feedback from the field with Marketing, Product and RevOps

• Report on team results and trends to sales leadership

Who you are

• 2+ years as a people manager of BDRs or SDRs (formal management, not team lead)

• 4+ years in B2B sales, including time as a top-performing BDR yourself

• You've owned a team's meetings or pipeline quota and consistently hit or exceeded it

• You coach by doing. You're comfortable leading strategy sessions, rewriting outreach and showing a rep what good looks like.

• You're comfortable with numbers and can use Salesforce reports to see where the team is winning and where it's stuck

• A clear, direct communicator who gives honest feedback in a way that helps people grow

• Organized and able to keep a fast-moving team on track without losing sight of each rep

• You like building. You're happy in a fast-growing startup where the playbook is still being written

• Team-first, low ego and excited to help other people succeed

Bonus points

• Experience leading BDRs in an SMB or mid-market motion

• Experience selling

title: Senior Clinical Informaticist
description:
About Mosai

Mosai ™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai , home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at​
Position Summary
Mosai is looking for a Senior Clinical Informaticist to be the clinical conscience of its AI and help drive AI-assisted health care at home. Working with data scientists and ML engineers, this person will own the clinical ground truth used to train and evaluate models, including what gets labeled, how it gets labeled, and whether outputs are safe and correct for nurses, therapists, and hospice teams to use.
As the first hire in the clinical informatics function, this hands-on senior leader will create annotation guidelines, label and adjudicate data, build gold-standard datasets, and lead clinical evaluation of models and LLM-based features. The role brings knowledge of how care is delivered and documented at home into the data and logic used by Mosai 's AI, while helping build the clinical informatics team.
Job Duties:

• Own clinical annotation: design labeling schemas and versioned guidelines for clinical notes, OASIS items, diagnoses, medications, wounds, functional status, and other home health and hospice concepts.

• Label and adjudicate data directly; engage appropriate in-house clinical resources, resolve annotator disagreements, make final clinical calls on edge cases, and build and maintain core gold-standard datasets for data science models.

• Work with MLOps and data science teams to report and monitor model performance and respond to drift in key accuracy metrics.

• Measure inter-annotator agreement using standard metrics, such as Cohen's or Fleiss' kappa; run calibration sessions, audit samples, and improve annotation guidelines and workflows.

• Evaluate model predictions and LLM-generated text for accuracy, completeness, hallucination, bias, and clinical safety.

• Design evaluation rubrics and help define clinical criteria for release of traditional ML and LLM-based models.

• Translate home health and hospice workflows, including start of care, recertification, resumption of care, discharge, hospice admission, and IDG, into structured data, rules, and features.

• Map clinical concepts to ICD-10-CM, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, OASIS, and hospice HOPE data elements; support EHR integration, including HomeCare HomeBase, using HL7 and FHIR.

• Define clinical data quality checks, document provenance and dataset versions, and apply HIPAA, minimum-necessary, and de-identification practices to labeling work.

• Support development of AI capabilities by demonstrating how skilled clinicians perform the same tasks.

• Partner with product and engineering on clinical requirements, pre-release validation, post-release model monitoring, and clinician feedback loops.

• Recruit, train, and mentor clinical annotators and junior informaticists as the program grows.

Minimum Requirements

• Active, unrestricted clinical license as an RN (BSN or equivalent), Physical Therapist, Occupational Therapist, or Speech-Language Pathologist.

• At least five years of clinical experience, including meaningful time in home health and/or hospice.

• At least four years in clinical informatics, such as informatics nursing, clinical analysis, clinical data abstraction, or quality, aligned with recognized standards such as the ANA Nursing Informatics Scope and Standards of Practice or AMIA health informatics core competencies.

• Core informatics competencies in clinical workflow analysis, data governance and quality, the system lifecycle (requirements, testing, validation, and go-live), and clinical decision support or quality measure logi
